From the rules for filling up pyramids, we get the following equations.
•	 a + b = 60
•	 12 + c = a
•	 c + 8 = b
From this, we see that,
•	 (12 + c) + (c + 8) = a + b = 60
Hence,
•	 20 + 2c = 60
•	 2c = 60 – 20 = 40
•	 c = 20.
Once we know c, we can find a and b, and complete the pyramid.
